head: Foldwriter typewriter app: a half-folded iPhone Duo types letters
dek: Foldwriter is a $1.99 app that shows paper on the top half of a half-folded iPhone Duo and typewriter keys below, with clacking keys and a margin bell. It was #51 among paid Entertainment apps on the US App Store on 18 November.
details: You pick from three machines with their own recorded sounds, eight papers and eight stamps, sign with a pen and send the letter as a picture, a PDF or a short video of it being typed. A room mode shows your surroundings through the camera behind the page, and the listing says nothing is recorded. It's in English and Dutch, one payment with no account, ads, subscription or tracking, from vanYperen.com; version 1.2.1 lets the Duo rest on either half.
where: iPhone, iOS 17 or later, $1.99 once (US price)
means: If you have an iPhone Duo, this is a playful way to type a letter or card and send it as a picture or video.
todo: Nothing to do; it's a one-off purchase if you want it.
